source: Names of other owners that the focus compiler may reference but cannot read from the staged files of earlier builder modules: patterns of name families (contract additions, Patterns) and the lists of decision E4 for allow_branch. A name a builder module writes is found by scanning the staged files and needs no entry. Add a name here only while its module does not exist yet; remove it when the module lands. <key> matches [a-z0-9_]+.
